name: Generalized anxiety disorder
description: Generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) is an anxiety disorder characterized by excessive, uncontrollable, and often irrational worry about events or activities. Worry often interferes with daily functioning.

name: Anxiety disorder, unspecified
description: Clinically significant anxiety symptoms that cause distress or impairment but do not meet full criteria for a specific anxiety disorder diagnosis.

name: Other phobic anxiety disorders
description: Phobic anxiety presentations, such as specific or social phobias, that do not fall under the more commonly coded phobia subtypes.

name: Phobic anxiety disorder, unspecified
description: An anxiety disorder marked by persistent, excessive fear of a specific object, activity, or situation that is out of proportion to actual danger, without a more specific phobia subtype documented.

name: Other mixed anxiety disorders
description: A psychiatric condition known as Other mixed anxiety disorders.

name: Other specified anxiety disorders
description: Anxiety presentations that cause clinically significant distress or impairment but do not meet full criteria for any specific anxiety disorder category.

name: Adjustment disorder with anxiety
description: An emotional response to an identifiable stressor, occurring within three months of the stressor's onset, in which anxiety is the predominant symptom.

name: Vascular dementia, mild, with anxiety
description: A mild form of dementia caused by reduced blood flow to the brain (e.g. after stroke or small-vessel disease), presenting with cognitive decline alongside clinically significant anxiety symptoms.

name: Psychotic disorder with delusions due to known physiological condition
description: A psychotic disorder in which delusions occur as a direct physiological consequence of a diagnosed general medical condition, rather than a primary psychiatric illness or substance use.

name: Alcohol dependence with alcohol-induced psychotic disorder with delusions
description: A psychotic disorder featuring delusions arising in the context of alcohol dependence, occurring during or shortly after heavy alcohol use or withdrawal.

name: Major depressive disorder, single episode, unspecified
description: Major depressive disorder (MDD), also known as clinical depression, is a mental disorder characterized by at least two weeks of pervasive low mood, low self-esteem, and loss of interest or pleasure in normally enjoyable activities. Introduced by a group of US clinicians in the mid-1970s, the term was adopted by the American Psychiatric Association for this symptom cluster under mood disorders in the 1980 version of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-III), and has become widely used since.
icd10_official_description: Major depressive disorder, single episode, unspecified

name: Persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia)
description: Dysthymia, known as persistent depressive disorder (PDD) in the DSM-5-TR and dysthymic disorder in ICD-11, is a psychiatric condition marked by symptoms that are similar to those of major depressive disorder, but which persist for at least two years in adults and one year among children. The term was introduced by Robert Spitzer in the late 1970s as a replacement for the concept of "depressive personality".

name: Bipolar disorder, unspecified
description: Bipolar disorder (BD), previously known as manic depression, is a mental disorder characterized by periods of depression and abnormally elevated mood, lasting days to weeks, and in some cases months. If the elevated mood is severe or associated with psychosis, it is called mania; if it does not significantly affect functioning, it is called hypomania.

name: Manic episode, unspecified
description: Mania is a psychiatric behavioral syndrome defined as a state of abnormally elevated mood with hyperactivity and risky behavior. During a manic episode, an individual will experience rapidly changing emotions and moods, highly influenced by surrounding stimuli.

name: Panic disorder [episodic paroxysmal anxiety]
description: Panic disorder is a chronic psychiatric condition characterized by recurrent, unexpected panic attacks accompanied by persistent concern about future attacks or significant behavioral changes related to them.

name: Obsessive-compulsive disorder, unspecified
description: Obsessive–compulsive disorder (OCD) is a mental disorder in which an individual has intrusive thoughts and feels the need to perform certain behaviors (compulsions) repeatedly to relieve the distress caused by the obsession, to the extent where it impairs general function. OCD has been described since antiquity and has affected numerous notable historical and contemporary figures; understandings of it were historically rooted in religion and beliefs about demonic possession.

name: Borderline personality disorder
description: Borderline personality disorder is a complex mental health condition characterized by pervasive instability in moods, behavior, self-image, and interpersonal relationships.

name: Intermittent explosive disorder
description: Intermittent explosive disorder is a behavioral condition characterized by repeated, sudden episodes of impulsive, aggressive, violent behavior or angry verbal outbursts that are grossly out of proportion to the situation.

name: Conduct disorder, unspecified
description: Conduct disorder (CD) is a mental disorder diagnosed in childhood or adolescence that is characterized by a repetitive and persistent pattern of antisocial behavior involving the violation of the basic rights of others or major age-appropriate norms. These behaviors may include theft, lying, physical violence, destruction, and rule-breaking.

name: Somatic symptom disorder
description: Somatic symptom disorder is characterized by extreme and disproportionate distress regarding physical symptoms, such as pain or fatigue, that significantly disrupts daily functioning.

name: Illness anxiety disorder
description: Illness anxiety disorder is a mental health condition characterized by an excessive, persistent preoccupation with having or acquiring a serious, undiagnosed medical illness, accompanied by minimal or no somatic symptoms and high levels of health-related anxiety.

name: Agoraphobia with panic disorder
description: Agoraphobia with panic disorder is an anxiety disorder in which a person has recurrent, unexpected panic attacks together with intense fear of places or situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable, leading to avoidance of those situations.

name: Body dysmorphic disorder
description: Body dysmorphic disorder is a mental health condition marked by persistent, intrusive preoccupation with a perceived flaw in physical appearance that is unnoticeable or only slightly noticeable to others, causing significant distress or repetitive checking/grooming behaviors.
